title: Brad Holmes says he and Dan Campbell are in "total lockstep" on offseason plan

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Brad Holmes says he and Dan Campbell are in "total lockstep" on offseason plan
sources.description: The Lions have had changes this offseason, losing David Montgomery, Alex Anzalone, Taylor Decker and Graham Glasgow, among others, while adding Isiah Pacheco, Juice Scruggs and Larry Borom, among others.
